_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED FOR PTERODACTYL PANEL - PTERODACTYL.IO
name: Floodman Operations Voice AIO v1.1.1
author: operations@floodman.com
description: Production-hardened all-in-one Floodman AI phone operations stack with embedded Asterisk, AVA, a Google-aware call gate, Twilio Elastic SIP Trunking runtime profiles with external one-time provisioning, controlled two-way test calls, inbound intake, scheduling, billing callbacks, customer recovery campaigns, Roomflow synchronization, diagnostics, and a responsive operations dashboard. The primary allocation is the HTTPS dashboard. Add SIP signaling and the configured RTP UDP range as separate allocations.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/data/tls
cat > /mnt/server/README-PTERODACTYL.txt <<'EOF'
Floodman Operations Voice AIO v1.1.1 is included in its Docker image.
Persistent data is created under /home/container/data at first launch.
For the first boot keep SIP_TRUNK_MODE=disabled, OUTBOUND_ENABLED=false,
TEST_CALLS_ENABLED=false, and STARTUP_PREFLIGHT=warn.

Twilio testing requires:
- the dashboard allocation
- UDP 5060 for initial SIP testing, or TCP 5061 for secure trunking
- every UDP port in RTP_START through RTP_END
- PUBLIC_IP set to the public address advertised in SIP and SDP
- Twilio trunk/domain, credential, number, and origination URI settings

The generated ADMIN_TOKEN is stored in /home/container/data/runtime.env and is
not printed unless PRINT_BOOTSTRAP_SECRETS=true.
EOF

variables.name: Runtime Environment
variables.description: Use production for live calls.

variables.name: Public Dashboard URL
variables.description: Externally reachable HTTPS base URL used for the dashboard and signed customer upload links, without a trailing slash.

variables.name: Trusted Dashboard Hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated Host header allowlist. Include the PUBLIC_BASE_URL hostname.

variables.name: Trusted Reverse Proxy IPs
variables.description: Comma-separated proxy IPs allowed to supply forwarded headers. Never use * in production.

variables.name: Force HTTPS Redirect
variables.description: Enable only after the reverse proxy supplies a trusted X-Forwarded-Proto header.

variables.name: Enable API Documentation
variables.description: Expose OpenAPI and Swagger only during controlled testing.

variables.name: Print Bootstrap Secrets
variables.description: Keep false so the admin token is stored only in data/runtime.env.

variables.name: Startup Preflight
variables.description: warn reports incomplete production settings; strict blocks startup; off disables the check.

variables.name: Default Time Zone
variables.description: IANA time zone used for scheduling and calling windows.

variables.name: SIP Trunk Mode
variables.description: Leave disabled for the first boot. Use twilio for Twilio Elastic SIP Trunking, registration for registered carriers, or ip for IP-authenticated carriers.

variables.name: SIP Port
variables.description: Public UDP allocation used for SIP signaling. Add this allocation to the Pterodactyl server.

variables.name: SIP TLS Port
variables.description: Asterisk TLS signaling port used by the secure Twilio profile.

variables.name: RTP Start Port
variables.description: First UDP media allocation. The full range through RTP_END must be assigned to this server.

variables.name: RTP End Port
variables.description: Last UDP media allocation. Must be greater than or equal to RTP_START.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address advertised to the SIP carrier for NAT traversal.

variables.name: Local Network CIDR
variables.description: Container or Wings network CIDR used by Asterisk NAT configuration.

variables.name: SIP Codecs
variables.description: Comma-separated codecs. Twilio testing should begin with ulaw.

variables.name: Twilio Termination URI
variables.description: Same Twilio FQDN used by Asterisk for outbound calls.

variables.name: Twilio SIP Username
variables.description: Digest-auth username attached to the Twilio trunk credential list.

variables.name: Twilio SIP Password
variables.description: Runtime SIP digest password. Provision the Twilio trunk outside the long-running server and paste only this SIP secret here.

variables.name: Twilio Phone Number
variables.description: Twilio-owned E.164 DID associated with the Elastic SIP Trunk.

variables.name: Twilio Caller ID Number
variables.description: Twilio-owned or verified E.164 number used for outbound calls.

variables.name: Twilio Secure Trunking
variables.description: Enable TLS signaling and SDES-SRTP after certificate paths and TCP 5061 are ready.

variables.name: Twilio Symmetric RTP
variables.description: Keep false when PUBLIC_IP and SDP are correct. Enable only as a diagnosed NAT workaround because source-address latching weakens media-path restrictions.

variables.name: SIP TLS Certificate Path
variables.description: Absolute path to the full certificate chain inside the server.

variables.name: SIP TLS Private Key Path
variables.description: Absolute path to the matching private key inside the server.

variables.name: SIP TLS CA Bundle
variables.description: CA bundle used to verify Twilio TLS certificates.

variables.name: Verify Twilio TLS Certificate
variables.description: Keep enabled in production.

variables.name: Enable Controlled Test Calls
variables.description: Allows only numbers listed in TEST_CALL_ALLOWLIST to receive the built-in two-way echo test.

variables.name: Test Call Allowlist
variables.description: Comma-separated operator-owned E.164 numbers. Leave blank while test calls are disabled.

variables.name: Enable Twilio Play Test Extensions
variables.description: Adds internal extensions 8990 and 8991 for Twilio free trunk verification numbers.

variables.name: SIP Server
variables.description: Carrier SIP hostname or IP address.

variables.name: SIP Username
variables.description: Registration username when SIP trunk mode is registration.

variables.name: SIP Password
variables.description: Registration password. Stored as a Pterodactyl environment variable and never written to repository files.

variables.name: SIP From User
variables.description: DID or carrier account identifier used in outbound SIP requests.

variables.name: SIP From Domain
variables.description: Optional carrier From domain.

variables.name: SIP Match Address
variables.description: Carrier signaling IP or CIDR used for an IP-authenticated trunk.

variables.name: SIP Outbound Proxy
variables.description: Optional carrier outbound proxy URI.

variables.name: Google Tracking DIDs
variables.description: Comma-separated DIDs primarily used by Google Ads or Local Services. These supplement audio classification and do not replace it.

variables.name: Live Transfer Number
variables.description: E.164 number used when a caller requests a human representative.

variables.name: Emergency Transfer Number
variables.description: E.164 number used for urgent active-water and safety escalations.

variables.name: Billing Transfer Number
variables.description: E.164 number used when billing assistance requires a person.

variables.name: Estimating Transfer Number
variables.description: E.164 number used for estimating and project-scope escalations.

variables.name: Outbound Caller ID Number
variables.description: Floodman-controlled caller ID number approved by the selected carrier.

variables.name: AVA Provider
variables.description: AVA provider/pipeline identifier. The supplied default uses AVA's local-hybrid pipeline.

variables.name: Auto-install AVA Local Models
variables.description: Downloads the selected AVA model tier into persistent storage at first launch. Leave false until resources have been reviewed.

variables.name: AVA Local Model Tier
variables.description: AVA model installation tier used when auto-install is enabled.

variables.name: Call Gate Enabled
variables.description: Enables the pre-greeting Google announcement and automated-caller classifier.

variables.name: Direct Caller Greeting Delay
variables.description: Maximum silence before the call gate fails open to the normal Floodman greeting. Google announcements can continue through the full gate window.

variables.name: Call Gate Whisper Model
variables.description: faster-whisper model used for the opening call classifier.

variables.name: Roomflow Enabled
variables.description: Enables remote Roomflow synchronization. The local operational ledger remains active either way.

variables.name: Roomflow Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for the Floodman Roomflow deployment.

variables.name: Roomflow API Token
variables.description: Bearer token used by the configurable Roomflow adapter.

variables.name: Roomflow Company ID
variables.description: Company identifier sent through X-COMPANY-ID.

variables.name: AMI Enabled
variables.description: Enables Asterisk Manager Interface access for scheduled outbound calls. Keep false until outbound configuration is complete.

variables.name: Outbound Campaigns Enabled
variables.description: Master switch for automated outbound calling. Compliance eligibility checks still run on every job.

variables.name: Outbound Concurrency
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous outbound jobs attempted by the worker.
